notes.title: 🚀 The Big PvP Update is Here! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey Commander, as promised it’s finally here!
A brand-new game mode has arrived, alongside tons of hotfixes and improvements.
And to celebrate the release: 50% OFF during the Steam Sale! 🪐✨

[b]⚔️ New Game Mode: PvP[/b]

[list]
[*] Play in teams or free-for-all against your friends.
[*] Control the center of the map and collect a brand-new resource.
[*] Use this resource to unleash enemies onto your opponents.
[*] The Roguelike mode is active during PvP for maximum chaos and action!
[*] You can now easily switch between Campaign and PvP in the planet selection screen.
[/list]

[b]🔧 Hotfixes & Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] ✅ Endless Mode now works properly again.
[*] 🎨 Planet 3 received a full graphical overhaul.
[*] 👾 Enemy behavior on Planet 3 has been fixed.
[*] 🪐 Platform layouts on Planet 3 have been adjusted they should no longer cause issues.
[/list]

🔥 Ready for battle? Jump into the all-new PvP Mode, challenge your friends, and grab Stellarcraft at 50% OFF during the sale!

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 17
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’re back with a small but important hotfix.

[h2]🆕 New[/h2]
[b]Drone now available in Endless Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now unlock and use the drone in Endless Mode.
[/list]

[h2]⚖️ Balancing[/h2]

[b]Drone collection behavior adjusted:[/b]
[list]
[*] The drone no longer collects a fixed 200 of each ore. Instead, it gathers exactly the amount mined by the Miner – regardless of ore type or color.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Bugfixes & Improvements[/h2]
[b]Default Language:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game now starts in English by default on first launch to avoid previous language issues.
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer – Depositing:[/b]
[list]
[*] All players can now deposit resources, not just the host.
[*] A bug that caused ores to go into negative values when depositing has been fixed.
[/list]

[b]Leaving the Lobby:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now leave the lobby properly again.
[/list]

[b]Dragon particles:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dragon particle effects are now visible to all players, not just the host.
[/list]

[b]Connection issue during Dragon spawn:[/b] 
[list]
[*] A bug that could cause players to disconnect when the dragon spawned has been resolved.
[/list]

[b]Drone particles in multiplayer:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Drone particle effects are now visible to all players in multiplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚀 Stellarcraft – Community Update Inspired by PhunkRoyal! 🌟
notes.notes:
[h2]🌌 Stellarcraft – Content Update Changelog 🌌[/h2]

[b]💬 A Huge Thank You to PhunkRoyal and His Amazing Community![/b]
We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to PhunkRoyal, a well-known German streamer, and his fantastic community!
Thanks to his stream, many new and friendly players have discovered Stellarcraft, and we’ve received an incredible amount of honest, helpful feedback.
This update is a direct response to your ideas and wishes — because your enjoyment matters most to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]⚙️ New Features & Improvements[/h2]

[b]🎯 Custom Difficulty Settings per Level[/b]
You now have full control over how each level plays:

[list]
[*] 👁️‍🗨️ Should enemies stop attacking towers?
[*] ⏱️ Should the next wave wait until all enemies are defeated?
[*] 🔥 Want to make things even harder?
[/list]

You decide — with per-level settings for challenge and pacing, everyone can find their perfect playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[b]🛠️ New Multi-Tool[/b]
Backed by community requests, this tool lets you act faster and smarter:

[list]
[*] ⚡ Upgrade towers instantly
[*] 🧱 Quickly demolish buildings
[*] 🎯 Assign targets with precision
[/list]

Efficiency at your fingertips!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[b]💠 New Base Upgrade: Auto-Heal[/b]
[list]
[*] A new base upgrade is available!
[*] Your base will now gradually heal itself over time — giving you more breathing room between intense waves.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Hotfixes & Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] 🐛 The Worm is now visible to all players again
[*] ✈️ The Airstrike no longer causes any errors
[*] 🖥️ Fixed FPS drops that occurred for some players
[*] ⚔️ Level 6 has been rebalanced to be more challenging
[*] ❗ Level 8: Fixed incorrect quest target display
[*] ✅ Level 9 & 10: Fixed quest-related bugs
[*] 😅 Fixed a bug where pressing the emote key could cause players to get stuck in UIs
[*] 📍 Adjusted misaligned quest objectives
[*] 👾 When new enemies spawn, it now correctly displays “New Enemies” instead of “New Towers”
[*] 🧱 In the Tutorial, it’s no longer possible to cheat resources
[*] 🚫 In Level 3, enemies no longer walk through walls
[*] 🌕 Brightness settings are now working again
[*] 🔫 Fixed an issue where ammo would sometimes disappear
[*] ✍️ Corrected multiple spelling errors across the game
[*] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]
We hope this update brings even more joy to your Stellarcraft experience!
As always:

🎙️ Your feedback shapes the future of Stellarcraft — keep it coming!

– Your Stellarcraft Team

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 16
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

We recently had a major bug in the game that affected some of you – especially in multiplayer. We're really sorry that this caused issues and stopped some players from fully enjoying the game.

We spent most of the night working hard to fix it as quickly as possible. Huge thanks to everyone who used the F1 feedback tool – your reports help us react super fast!

[b]🛠️ Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] ✅ Multiplayer is now working correctly again.
[*] ✅ All players can now properly see enemies again.
[*] ✅ Towers now reappear correctly when restarting a level.
[/list]

Thanks so much for your patience and support!
Your Stellarcraft Team ❤️

notes.title: 🌌 Stellarcraft – The Biggest Update Ever Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Stellarcraft community,[/b]

This update is more than just a patch – it’s a true milestone! You’ll explore a completely new planet with five fresh levels, gain access to a second massive hub, experiment with new weapons, face off against unique enemies and bosses, and enjoy tons of improvements to your gameplay experience.

[b]🎉 To celebrate: Stellarcraft is 50% OFF for a limited time! 🚀[/b]

[previewyoutube=mrF_thsEEv4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🪐 New Planet: 5 New Levels + Endless Mode![/h2]

[list]
[*] Explore five brand-new levels featuring fresh enemies, unique environments, and exciting challenges.
[*] All five levels are now available in Endless Mode – for infinite combat and replayability.
[*] Revamped quests in each new level – more dynamic and immersive than ever.
[*] Each level comes with its own original soundtrack to enhance the atmosphere.
[*] Both the former Level 5 Boss and the new Level 10 Boss now appear in Endless Mode!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]👾 New Enemies & Boss Fights[/h2]

[b]New Enemy Types:[/b]

[list]
[*] 🐉 Poison-Breathing Dragon – unleashes deadly poison area attacks.
[*] 🐍 Burrowing Wurm – emerges unexpectedly from the ground.
[*] 🧙 Dark Mage – summons swarms of hostile bats.
[/list]

[b]New Elite Enemies:[/b]

[list]
[*] 🛡️ Knight Elite 1 (Type: Earth)
[*] 🌪️ Wind Cactus (Type: Wind)
[/list]

[b]New Boss Battle:[/b]

[list]
[*] A powerful new final boss awaits in Level 10 – smarter, tougher, and more epic than anything before.
[*] Now also available in Endless Mode, alongside the classic Level 5 boss.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🛸 Two Hubs – A Bigger World Awaits[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hub 1 – your starting point for upgrades and access to early content.
[*] NEW: Hub 2 – a massive spaceship hub unlocked after completing Level 5.
Discover new shops, features, and advanced systems.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🔫 Weapons & Attachments[/h2]

[list]
[*] A brand-new Weapon Shop is now open – claim the first of many new weapons!
[*] Four weapon attachments now available – customize your loadout with unique builds.
[*] Weapon attachment functionality has been fixed and works as intended.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🧿 New Relics & Collectibles[/h2]

[list]
[*] Six new relics with powerful and fun effects have been added.
[*] Every level (1–10) now contains at least one relic to discover.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]⚙️ Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Revamped pause menu with improved clarity and structure.
[*] Updated settings menu – cleaner, easier to navigate.
[*] You can now equip hats to your skin from the lobby screen.
[*] Credit indicator at the upgrade table now turns red if you lack resources.
[*] Mobile Miners can now be placed in toxic zones.
[*] New in-game Skin Editor – customize your look live in-game!
[*] Tower unlocks now follow the correct order.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]📖 Logbook Enhancements[/h2]

[list]
[*] The logbook has been visually overhauled – cleaner, modern, and more stylish.
[*] New feature: The logbook now shows the damage type of each tower.
[*] Logbook functionality has been further stabilized.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🎨 Visual & Atmosphere Enhancements[/h2]

[list]
[*] All levels received major visual updates – more vibrant, colorful, and detailed.
[*] Level 1 received extra polish for a more striking start.
[*] Level 4 is now brighter and easier to navigate.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]⚖️ Balancing Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Stomper Tower now costs 500 of each resource – balanced for its high power.
[*] Player movement has been slightly adjusted for smoother control.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] ✔️ Level 5 can now be completed reliably.
[*] ✔️ Enemies no longer spawn inside walls in Level 5.
[*] ✔️ Flashlight in Level 4 now works as expected.
[*] ✔️ Flying enemies removed from Level 1.
[*] ✔️ VR headset no longer floats in the tutorial area of Hub 1.
[*] ✔️ Fixed overlapping textures on the base.
[*] ✔️ Logbook now functions properly and more reliably.
[*] ✔️ Improved main menu animations.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support, feedback, and patience. This update marks a huge leap forward for Stellarcraft – and it’s only the beginning!

Enjoy the new content – explore, fight, experiment!

Your Stellarcraft Team 🚀

notes.title: 📢 Changelog – Weapons & Systems Update
notes.notes:
[b]🎉 Update Highlight[/b]
To celebrate this update, we're running a 30% sale – so don’t miss out!
Development on the second planet is ongoing. The timeline has shifted slightly, as we wanted to take more time to respond to your feedback in this update.
So not only can you enjoy a wide range of new features and improvements now – the new planet is also nearly ready for Playtesting!

[b]🛠️ Weapon System Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] The weapon mechanics have been completely reworked, offering a more intense and precise gameplay experience.
[*] New Hit Feedback: Improved visual and audio effects when hitting enemies.
[*] Recoil System: Each weapon now has individual recoil, making handling more realistic and dynamic.
[*] Weapon Attachments & Mods: Unlock various attachments via the level system. Each offers strategic advantages and trade-offs for deeper tactical gameplay.
[*] Aiming Down Sights: You can now aim with all weapons – with or without scopes – giving combat more depth and precision.
[/list]

[b]🏠 Hub Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon Locker: View and manage all collected weapons in one central place.
[*] Upgrade Station: Improve and customize your weapons directly in the hub.
[*] New Track in the Hub: A new soundtrack adds to the hub’s atmosphere.
[*] Prevent Leaving the Hub: Players can no longer accidentally leave the hub.
[/list]

[b]🧱 Build Mode Improvements[/b]
Jumping in Build Mode: You can now jump while in build mode for smoother navigation.
Single vs. Multi-Build Mode: New toggle to switch between precise single building and fast multi-building – place towers much quicker!

[b]🔦 Level Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 4 – Cave Overhaul: The caves are now much darker, increasing tension and immersion. To help you navigate, a flashlight has been added.
[/list]

[b]📈 Interface & Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The Tower Selection button has been visually redesigned to be clearer and more intuitive.
[*] The Feedback Tool is now directly accessible from the main menu.
[*] A loading icon now appears when sending feedback, so you know it's being submitted.
[/list]

[b]Minimap Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] New icon for the player location.
[*] New icons highlighting points of interest worth checking out.
[/list]


[b]🔧 Bug Fixes & Technical Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] A potential crash in the tutorial has (hopefully) been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused black screens in the main menu has been addressed.
[*] After base destruction, you can no longer get stuck in the minimap.
[*] Visual glitches in the Tower Unlock Table have been fixed.
[/list]

[b]🗺️ Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Roadmap Updated: The future development roadmap has been revised – viewable in the main menu as always.
[/list]

[b]💬 Thank You[/b]
Thank you so much for your continued support, feedback, and bug reports!
We're hard at work on the second planet and on squashing any remaining bugs.

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 15
notes.notes:
[b]🔫 Modular Weapon System in Internal Playtest![/b]
The recently announced weapon customization system with attachments is now in internal testing and almost ready for release! Get ready for more tactical depth and personalization.

[h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]

[b]🛠️ Stability Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] 🐛 A bug that occasionally caused the game to crash has been resolved.
[/list]

[b]🎮 Controller & Mouse Input Tweaks[/b]

[list]
[*] Mouse control in combination with a controller has been improved – input is now more precise.
[*] Cursor speed for controller navigation has been adjusted for smoother handling.
[/list]

[b]🧱 Stuck Fix in Base Area[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck behind a building block inside the base.
[/list]

[b]🧍‍♂️🧍‍♀️ Second Player Now Receives Relics Properly[/b]

[list]
[*] Resolved a bug where the second player occasionally didn’t receive relics as intended.
[/list]

[b]🏚️ Quest Handling When Base Is Destroyed[/b]

[list]
[*] Quests are now correctly removed from the HUD when the base has been destroyed.
[/list]

🔥💥 Proper Weapon Unlock Display in Logbook

[list]
[*] Flamethrower and Rocket Launcher no longer appear in the logbook by default – they will now only show up once unlocked. No more spoilers!
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for our game.
With every hotfix, feature, and idea – we're building this together.

Stay tuned – the best is yet to come! 💥
Until the next update: Have fun and enjoy the game! 🎮🔥

Your Dev Team ❤️

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 14
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]
We’ve prepared a small hotfix for you, as we received a few more bug reports recently. Thanks so much to everyone who keeps sharing feedback – it really helps! 🙌

The next big update is already in the works and will feature a brand-new planet with lots of exciting new content! We’ll be teasing some of it very soon so you can get a sneak peek. 🪐✨

But for now, let’s get into the current changelog:

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/h2]

[b]Build Menu:[/b] Fixed an issue where the build menu sometimes didn’t respond properly.

[b]Level 4:[/b] Added a pickup sound effect for collecting building parts.

[b]Level 5:[/b] The keycard now also has a pickup sound.

[b]Towers:[/b] Towers can now be placed with a left-click – more intuitive and user-friendly!

[h2]🌿 Level Updates:[/h2]

[b]Level 1:[/b] Floating grass has been fixed and is now properly grounded.

[b]Level 2:[/b] Fire and smoke effects have been restored.

[b]Level 3:[/b] Lotus flowers and leaves are now visible again.

[b]Level 4:[/b] The texture of the large outer rocks has been updated – they now look more like a canyon instead of being plain-colored.

[b]Level 5:[/b] All floating small stones should now be properly placed on the ground.

Thanks again for your support and happy playing! 💙
– Your Dev Team

notes.title: Hotfix 13
notes.notes:
[b]Hello dear Tower Defense community,[/b]

We have once again fixed several issues reported by you and are continuing to address any problems as they arise. Additionally, we are preparing the next big content update, which will finally take you to the second planet. Stay tuned!

[b]changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Ores in the level are now displayed side by side instead of overlapping.
[*] The compass has been made slightly transparent.
[*] A movement bug after leaving the level has been fixed.
[*] A mouse display issue related to Endless Mode has been fixed.
[/list]

We look forward to more feedback and hope you enjoy playing!

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
The Stellarcraft Team

notes.title: Major Content and Stability Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello dear Tower Defense community, [/b]

We took our time, but it was worth it! In addition to the long-awaited base upgrades, we have implemented numerous new features and improvements – including a comprehensive controller overhaul.  

The game has been completely revamped and expanded with many long-awaited features. We’ve also fixed all reported bugs. If you come across any more, feel free to report them in the Steam discussion or via the in-game F1 tool.  

A huge thank you to everyone who supports us and provides regular feedback!

[b]changelog[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]
                                                               [b]New[/b]

[b]Base Upgrades:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] The base can now be upgraded in the hub.  
[*] Pre-installed turrets are available and can be upgraded in multiple stages.  
[*] More HP can be added to the base.  
[*] A shield can be added to the base.  
[*] Two additional stairs for easier access to the base.  
[/list]

[b]Level Overhaul:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Level 1, 2 & 3: Extensive rework – large parts of the map have been redesigned to improve graphics.  
[*] Level 4: Additional tower slots added and map errors fixed.  
[*] Level 5: Reduced in size to improve performance and allow for more details.  
[/list]  

[b]Wooden Barricade:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Can be crafted and placed on enemy paths.  
[*] Slows down or blocks enemies.  
[*] Has limited durability and can be destroyed.  
[*] Enemies avoid obstacles when possible.  
[/list]  

[b]Improved Enemy AI:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Enemies now target specific points of the base.  
[*] These attack points are visually indicated.  
[/list]  

[b]Revamped Tower Selection:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] The tower selection has been completely redesigned and seamlessly integrated into the game.  
[*] A more intuitive interface allows for more efficient use during gameplay.  
[/list]  

[b]Ping Functionality:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Players can now place pings in the game to communicate important information.  
[*] The middle mouse button allows up to three pings to be placed simultaneously to highlight strategic positions.  
[/list]  

[b]The Logbook has been reworked:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Elite enemies are now displayed as well.  
[*] Additionally, the base upgrade table has been added.  
[/list]

[b]Endless Mode:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] New card added for the wooden barricade.  
[*] New card added for the mobile mining laser.  
[*] Cards now enlarge when over with the mouse/controller.  
[/list]  

[b]UI Optimization:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] The info display in the level selection is now collapsed by default and can be expanded via a new button in the upper corner.  
[*] The tower selection area has been removed from this menu and placed in a new UI location.  
[*] The interaction window now opens faster.  
[/list]  

[b]Hub Overhaul:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Graphical rework of the hub.  
[*] New sound effects & animations.  
[*] Secret location added.  
[*] Reworked relic table.  
[*] Relics now have a floating effect.  
[/list]  

[b]Control Overhaul:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] We have completely reworked the game controls in the background. While the gameplay may feel unchanged to you, this change was crucial for enabling future features like sneaking or quick-build mode. Previously, key bindings couldn't be used multiple times in different UI sections, which caused issues, especially with controllers. Now, the controls are more flexible and optimized – a big step for future updates!  

[*] Additionally, we’ve laid the foundation for allowing you to adjust UI sizes or hide certain elements entirely in the future. We're continuing to work on this to provide even more customization options!  
[/list]  

[b]Upgraded Towers:[/b]  
Players now receive upgrade ores back based on the HP of upgraded towers.  

[b]New Secrets:[/b]  
An additional relic has been hidden in Levels 4 and 5.

[b]Statistics Overhaul:[/b]  
The escape menu now displays how much XP is needed for the next level in the statistics section.  

[b]Player Upgrades with Description:[/b]  
Before unlocking a player upgrade, a detailed description is now shown, explaining the benefits and effects of the upgrade. This helps you make informed decisions before developing your skills.  

[b]UI Update:[/b]  
The font of the new wave display has been adjusted.  

[b]Trade Improvement:[/b]  
Selling all ores can now be canceled by pressing the same button again.  

[b]Radio:[/b]  
The radio feature has been reworked.  

[b]Translations:[/b]  
If a language is missing translations, the English text will now be displayed instead of an error.  

[b]Tutorial Cutscene:[/b]  
A new indicator in the tutorial now informs players that the cutscene can be skipped by pressing the spacebar.  

[b]Blueprint Table:[/b]  
Now highlights in red if there aren’t enough ores available.  

[b]Voting Tool:[/b]  
Controller icon added.  

[b]Sound Effects Reworked[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Weapon shot sound: New  
[*] Weapon reload sound: New  
[*] Mining laser sound: New  
[*] Overworld spaceship hover sound: New  
[*] Out-of-ammo sound: New  
[*] Weapon switch sound: New  
[*] Rocket launcher explosion sound: New  
[*] Gatling gun shot sound: New  
[/list]

[b]Inventory[/b]
The quantity of items in the inventory is now also displayed in the hotbar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]  

[list]  
[*] The difficulty in Endless Mode has been adjusted to make it challenging but not impossible.  
[*] The "Deposit Ores" task has been removed in Levels 4 and 5 to significantly speed up the progression in these stages.  
[*] Railgun: Costs reduced from 800 units of ore to 150 units per ore.  
[*] Rocket Launcher: Costs adjusted from 750 units of ore to 300 units of turquoise ore and 400 units of purple ore.  
[*] The Elite 1 Exploder was previously three times as fast but has now been reduced to double speed. This allows it to be attacked more easily by other turrets, improving the balance.  
[*] The explosion resistance of the Elite 1 Slime has been removed.  
[*] The Elite 1 Mushroom is now resistant to fire.  
[*] In Endless Mode, the map that grants +5% damage for every nearby turret has been adjusted. Instead of -5%, the same turret now only gets -2.5%.  
[*] Some enemies have been removed from the tutorial to make it easier.  
[/list]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png[/img]

[b]Bugs[/b]  

[list]  
[*] In multiplayer mode, the player could no longer move in the base (hub) in certain situations. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] In the tutorial, it was possible to get stuck when leaving the level during an active tutorial animation. This issue has been fixed.  
[*] If an error occurred during saving, the save file would be reset. This problem has been fixed.  
[*] The flickering of lights in some levels occasionally occurred and has now been corrected.  
[*] Tower upgrades were not updated after crafting. This was just a display issue, which has now been fixed.  
[*] Player icons were no longer displayed on the compass. This problem has been fixed.  
[*] In the deposit terminal, the wave display overlapped in the UI. This has been corrected.  
[*] A display error related to the wave display has been fixed.

notes.title: Endless mode & UI update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello, dear Tower Defense community,[/b][/h1]  

After several weeks of intense preparation, the time has finally come: a major update for Stellarcraft is now live! To celebrate this special moment, we’re kicking things off with an exclusive 20% discount on the entire game.

The update introduces extensive adjustments and new features – including a brand-new mode that is sure to thrill roguelike fans.

[h3][b]changelog[/b][/h3]

[h1]Endless Mode in Roguelike Style[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/4467f0d33e5b4ed06a0080c6c3221b1cbd047da2.gif[/img]

In the new Endless Mode of Stellarcraft, you’ll face an exciting roguelike-style challenge that you can activate after completing a mission or level. In this mode, you’ll have the chance to choose from three randomly selected cards after each wave. Each card grants you special abilities and bonuses – with over 40 different effects and card types available. Most cards can be stacked, amplifying their effects with each new card you add.

An exception are crafting items, which are needed to build and upgrade your towers and can also be collected in Endless Mode.

Collect all the 4-star rewards you earn for reaching specific waves! These stars will play an important role in upcoming updates and can, for example, be exchanged for cosmetic items.


[h1]New User Interface[/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/e0002b411da8e7f296386623f892ec4508f9c8bc.gif[/img]

The entire user interface of Stellarcraft has been redesigned, now featuring a modern, visually appealing layout that enhances the gaming experience. These optimizations not only improve the game's visual aesthetics but also contribute to a noticeable boost in performance. Experience Stellarcraft in a whole new light and enjoy the enhanced look and feel!


[h1]Removal of Halloween Graphics[/h1]  

The Halloween themes and graphics have been removed from Stellarcraft following the end of the event. The game is now returning to its classic look, focusing on upcoming updates and new content.

We look forward to more feedback and wish you a great time playing!

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
The Stellarcraft Team
